verses.text: Then David said, "This is the site of the house of the LORD God, and this is where Israel's altar for burnt offerings belongs."
David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to be gathered, and he assigned stonecutters to shape blocks for God's house.
He stockpiled iron for the nails in the gate doors and for the fittings, and more bronze than anyone could weigh.
He also gathered more cedar logs than anyone could count, because the people of Sidon and Tyre brought him so many.

David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house for the LORD must be magnificent, famous and honored in every land. I'll get things ready for it." So David made extensive preparations before he died.
Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him with building a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
David told Solomon, "I wanted to build a house that would honor the name of the LORD my God.
But the LORD gave me this message: 'You've shed a great deal of blood and fought major wars. You won't build a house to honor my name, because you've shed so much blood on the earth in my sight.
You will have a son who will be a man of peace. I'll give him rest from the enemies all around him. His name will be Solomon, and I'll give Israel peace and quiet while he lives.
He will build a house for my name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. I'll establish his royal throne over Israel forever.'
Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and give you success as you build the house of the LORD your God, just as he said you would.
May the LORD give you good judgment and understanding when he puts you in charge of Israel, so you can keep the law of the LORD your God.
You'll succeed if you carefully follow the statutes and rulings the LORD gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and brave. Don't be afraid or lose heart.

Look, even in my hardship I've set aside a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, and more bronze and iron than anyone can weigh, all for the LORD's house. I've also gathered timber and stone, and you can add more.
You have plenty of workers, including stonecutters, stoneworkers, carpenters, and people skilled in every kind of work.
There's more gold, silver, bronze, and iron than anyone can count. Get up and get to work, and may the LORD be with you."
David also told all Israel's leaders to help his son Solomon. He said,
"Isn't the LORD your God with you? Hasn't he given you peace on every side? He handed the people of this land over to me, and the land is now under the authority of the LORD and his people.

So give your whole heart and soul to following the LORD your God. Get up and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, so you can bring the ark of the LORD's covenant and God's sacred vessels into the house built for the LORD's name."
